items.title: Tommy Ridgley Interview, 1986-06-20
items.q: Now, as Sean Robinson is playing guitar. Sean's playing guitar.

ctx.x: Asked me forgiveness and something on your mind. Now, as Sean Robinson is playing guitar. Sean's playing guitar. Listen to that. Bad, bad, bad guitar. And you know what? He's so good, there's nobody who can duplicate Sean. And you know, he's in town. You know what? Come and think of it. I'm going to call Sean for some gigs. You ought to. I bet he would.
You know, I'm going to call him because he ain't doing nothing. Well, that's what I hear.
